notes: env: python 3.14.3, node 24.14, git 2.50; no make, no uv, no docker on this machine
all pinned deps verified installable with cp314 wheels incl. ortools, scipy, cryptography
M1: money-lint (AST) + hypothesis prove no float can enter a money path, both directions
M2: RFC 6962 Merkle log verified exhaustively (130 sizes vs recursive oracle, 1225 consistency pairs); verify() localises tampering by index AND by tree size
M3: posting requires a cryptographically valid audit receipt (subject-bound); policy engine is total under 300-example property test
M4: metrics.json is byte-identical across processes and under PYTHONHASHSEED=random; cost model says the selftest fixture is net-negative vs manual, reported not tuned away
M5: labels generated first, data derived; 4 integrity properties enforced by tests (labels balance, no hint leakage, opaque row ids, recon cannot import truth)
M6 baseline: precision 1.000 / recall 0.0599 over 3808 true pairs; 1 LLM call across 535 rows. Stage 1 is intentionally low-recall.
M7: PC 1.0000 / RR 0.9914 at 5,481 rows. Per-strategy measurement removed 10,236 useless pairs (amount buckets) and 638,111 (token counterparty keys).

M7 corrections to ground truth: explicit 1:1 payment-invoice links (recall denominator was 15x too large), settlement ids (UTR matches scored as false positives), and settlement UTR now equals its bank credit's UTR.

M8: EM was fitting on the Stage-1 residue (biased) and learned inverted date weights; both fixed. Deduplication added - the 5 remaining false positives were duplicate payments at +47.9 bits that no threshold could exclude.

M9: five solver errors that each satisfied their constraints - inverted tolerance, telescoping objective, calendar missing from the objective, per-row instead of per-relation groups, wall-clock budget breaking determinism.
M9 finding: precision FALLS as the solver budget rises (0.9169 at 0.5 units, 0.8329 at 2.0). The objective is a proxy; optimising it harder is not free.

M10: fitting on ALL settlements gave card_debit 2524 bps vs contracted 90; restricting to fee-consistent settlements gave R^2 0.919. Thin-volume methods are reported as unidentifiable rather than fitted.
M10: solver optimality is not correctness - Stage 4 claiming 0.95 on proven-optimal netting dropped auto-post precision to 0.977. Netting is a proposal until M12 calibrates it.
M11: one LLM gateway; injection scanned at INGEST not just the model boundary, else the denial was invisible when a later stage resolved the row.
M11: cassettes are synthetic fixtures, labelled as such, generated through the real call path and from the model's own inputs only - never ground truth.
M12: alpha=2% breaches on a single split but holds in expectation over 40 splits - both reported. Breach rate 32.5% at alpha=2%.
M12: an id-space mismatch made calibration silently fall back to the hard-coded 0.90 it existed to replace, while printing a plausible threshold.
M13: Razorpay boundary enforced by literal allowlist + import-time assertion + READ_ONLY; offline rail goes through the same gate so it is exercised on the path everyone runs.
M13: forecast_cash reports its own absence rather than fabricating a series until M14 lands.

M14: coverage was 77.4% vs 90% nominal from two errors - residuals taken from data the model trained on, and one pooled residual set sizing every horizon step. True split conformal + per-step calibration fixed both.
M14: build() went 310s -> 98s after caching calendar features (they were 2/3 of fit time) and sizing HistGBR to 175 rows (max_bins 255 -> 32).
M15: the worst Q&A bug was answering with a TRUE number about the wrong question - 'how much did we lose to fraud' matched CASH_TOTAL on 'how much'. A topic gate now runs before any pattern.
